body:
9f09e5ccd9 pushed (no force), 0 behind origin/main.
B1: harness wrapped in a cfg(target_os=linux) module; scripts/check-portability.sh is clean.
B2: not a race. lib-1 failed the TASK-1262 lint (no_cli_source_outside_the_resolver_uses_raw_current_executable_lookup) because fixture_tempdir called current_exe(). Fixtures now go under the workspace target/ via CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; the lint passes.
B3: build_claude_resume_exec_command goes through os_wrap (interactive_claude_program_and_args), with a test.
B4: agent_new_bg_dispatch refuses before preview/claim/lease/clone/pin. The test asserts no lease, no clone dir, no pin, no worktree; with the early refusal removed it fails, because the launch then runs, which also shows the late tree-config backstop alone is not enough.
minor: os_wrap layer argv now comes from os_wrapped_program_and_args itself.
Gates: check-ci-fast (32 ok), test-touched (776 ok), check-ci-compile ok, clippy clean. Docs updated (resume + early refusal).
subject: PR-2787 round 1 addressed (BUG-2169 S2)
